_demo_notice: DEMO_DATA: Curated for NextStep Career Guidance platform demonstration and testing.
title: Cybersecurity Analyst
overview: A Cybersecurity Analyst protects an organization's computer networks, cloud infrastructure, and sensitive systems from cyber threats, unauthorized access, and vulnerabilities. They monitor real-time network traffic, triage security alerts, analyze security breaches, and implement defensive countermeasures.
education_requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience

entry_level.title: Junior SOC Analyst (Tier 1)
entry_level.focus: Monitoring SIEM logs, triage alert queues, basic packet analysis, initial incident escalation.

mid_level.title: Security Analyst (Tier 2 / Incident Responder)
mid_level.focus: In-depth incident response, threat hunting, vulnerability management, malware triage.

senior_level.title: Senior Security Analyst / Security Engineer (Tier 3)
senior_level.focus: Security architecture review, automation (SOAR), threat intelligence modeling, forensics.

required_technical_skills: Networking Fundamentals (TCP/IP, OSI model, DNS, DHCP, subnetting)
Linux Command Line and System Administration
SIEM Tools (Splunk, Elastic SIEM, Microsoft Sentinel)
Security Frameworks (NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK)
recommended_certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP - Senior level)
Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) or GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC)
career_roadmap: Step 1: Master computer networking (TCP/IP, routing, DNS) and Linux command line operations.
Step 2: Learn Python scripting to parse logs, automate tasks, and interact with REST APIs.
Step 3: Gain hands-on defensive security skills in labs (TryHackMe SOC Level 1, LetsDefend).
Step 4: Build a home SOC lab using Splunk Free or ELK stack with Sysmon log ingestion.
Step 6: Apply for Entry-level SOC Analyst Tier 1 positions with portfolio projects.
source: NextStep Career Knowledge Base - Cybersecurity Domain v1.0
